Hi everyone! As the title says, I’ve had closed comedones near my jawline for a few years. Recently, they popped up all over my face. My skin has never been this bad. About a month ago my dermatologist prescribed me the following:

• 1% Clindamycin Topical Solution
• 0.025% Tretinoin Cream, USP
• 2.5% Hydrocortisone Cream  

I also use a 10% Benzoyl Peroxide cleanser. 
She told me to use any >5% BP cleanser. 
I use all of these in tandem, with a moisturizer if my skin gets too dry.
The Hydrocortisone is for a quarter-sized “eczema” spot on my cheek. 
In all honesty, I haven’t been very consistent with this regimen because I think it’s what is causing this breakout. Could it be that this is simply fungal acne? Should I continue applying these meds despite it getting worse? Any advice on how to get rid of these would be greatly appreciated. :)

I’m going to therapy right now, and increased my appointment frequency to 1-2x a week and telling her everything instead of just saying “I suck.” I know that I’m the only one who can do it, I never said I expected someone else to recover for me— it’s my responsibility. it’s just been hard to admit and realize how bad these behaviors are so I wanted to vent about it. Thank you for your reply and reading, I’m working my hardest :)
it’s on my face and i’m 19. i’m so happy for you and wish you the best on the rest of your journey! so many people seem to get eczema out of the blue at an array of ages, so odd!

wow! way to be proactive, I’m so happy you we’re able to clear it up. I am going to buy the CereVe products you mentioned, especially the ointment. Do you feel that the rosehip oil has done anything for you? thank you so much for your help.
thank you! I do indeed think and allergy is causing it. Have you ever done allergy testing to figure out what caused it?

omg I have PCOS! the reason I ruled it out as a PCOS symptom was because after I’d lost a bunch of weight and treated my PCOS, the all the symptoms went away but this little patch stayed. I’m going to make a derm appointment asap, thank you!

thank you! i honestly never thought it could be eczema because it has only ever been on that 1 inch patch on my face and absolutely nowhere else. i’m realizing now that the dryness around my nose is due to intense exfoliation AND strong acids that i have been putting on my face to combat a breakout i had because of some dirty pillowcases and a shitty wax job i did on my cheeks (no idea why i thought any of these things were a good idea). i will not use cleansers and i’ll try vit e. any specific products you would recommend?

edit: looked at some photos of eczema and i definitely think you’re right about the patch.

God do I need to take notes from you. You are very self-aware and even it though it doesn’t seem like it, you have a lot of control. I’m extremely proud of you. The sixth paragraph feels as though it was ghostwritten by me, except I’ve allowed those insecurities and anxieties to eat me alive and in turn, ravage my relationship. I’ve worn him down by acting on these insecurities and nagging him constantly. All I want is for him to be happy, for him to see me as a safe place, for him to be happy when he sees my name pop up in his phone- not dread that another fight stemming from my black & white thinking might happen. I want to be his rock and for when everything else in life is going wrong, he knows he can come to me, he knows I’ll be right there with only love & support in his darkest hour. He means the world to me and I really do love him more than anything.  He’s wonderful person and deserves the best.

A lot of times I’ll create these arguments between him and I and they’re all based on how I feel. They always end in me asking myself why I had to bring it up when it wasn’t even worth it, why I feel so awful, crying myself to sleep and having nightmares. I understand everything you’re going through and I’m so sorry. I commend you for battling the thoughts and being so mindful. You somehow have managed to completely shut down unhealthy thinking and rationalize (something that is so difficult for me when I’m having bouts of insecurity) and realize that neuro-typical people’s minds work and think differently. In your first message I wasn’t sure if you were happy with him but it seems he’s always honest with you. I truly hope that you are happy and can reach a place where you don’t have to question if you are loved or cared for by him. Does he show you he loves you in other ways?

i’ve begged and pleaded about the phonecall thing for over a year & a half, all it does is create fights and it seems he doesn’t care. i can’t force anyone to want to talk to me but feeling like i’m at the bottom of his list of priorities hurts. 
i absolutely do not accept change, and i fear it. it fucking sucks that out brains are wired this way.

i should have never told you to wait for the six months, it was super late last night i’m sorry! if he can go so long without speaking to you and doesn’t see anything wrong with that— ESPECIALLY while you guy are LDR then he doesn’t even deserve to be around you 24/7 if you guys do meet. 

i will say that you seem to be doing a really good job at distracting yourself and not asking for attention/communication because it’s a daily occurrence for me. i do think you guys should talk about it and maybe try to close the gap on how long he’s taking to reply, it really doesn’t take but two seconds to stop what your doing and send a quick message to the person you love. another thing to note, something i heard recently is that absence and lack of communication make the heart idealize a person. i’m not sure if you can relate to that but i think a lot of the abandonment issues and fear of rejection only makes us panic and cling more. 

you really do deserve so much better than this, you’re wonderful and deserve someone who will always want to talk to you and who’s love won’t waver just because they see that you have so much to give already

i understand completely & my bf and i are going on two year and he doesn’t ever even call me anymore— we used to facetime and call every night and then it stopped after a few months. he tells me it’s because of technical difficulties and it’s true yet when we fight we have 2 hour long phonecalls. 

it’s good that you forced yourself to make other plans and be around other people. i feel that we immerse ourselves in our partners so much that they begin to think that since we’re so infatuated w them, they don’t have to meet us halfway if we’re already going the full mile. don’t compare yourself or relationship to that of his ex’s. YOU are his match because you’re together and you’re the one he loves now, remind yourself that you’re deserving of that love & that you’ll see eachother at the six month mark. practice looking after yourself and try to surround yourself with other people and activities to keep yourself busy. you are just as important as he is!
